subject: Pre-procurement compliance bundle request / PO prerequisites
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@kilnhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@kilnhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Pre-procurement compliance bundle request — Kiln Health

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Kiln will be moving to a formal PO for the pilot and procurement needs a short compliance bundle before they can issue the PO. Can you please provide the following artifacts (redacted where required):

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- Penetration test attestation or summary of findings
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached sample below)
- Data Processing Addendum or template agreement
- Proof of insurance (GL and cyber)

We would appreciate a consolidated zip or shared Drive folder. Target timeline on our side is to receive these by end of week so we can escalate to legal and issue the PO next Tuesday.

Attaching the procurement intake spreadsheet for your vendor team to fill: Kiln_Security_PreReqs.xlsx (we'll populate fields on our end too).

Feel free to loop in your procurement or security SMEs — I'm happy to coordinate a quick call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Kiln Health
procurement@kilnhealth.com

---
Attachment: Kiln_Security_PreReqs.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@kilnhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pre-procurement compliance bundle request — Kiln Health

Emily — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. We've started collating materials. Quick notes and asks so we can get you everything in one pass: 

- SOC2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF and a SOC 2 bridge letter for scope/context. Redaction will remove customer names and specific configs.
- ISO: we have an ISO 27001 certificate for the control plane; I'll confirm the cert number and include a copy.
- Pen test: Redwood has an external pen test attestation from 2025; we'll include the attestation letter and a short, non-sensitive summary of findings and remediation.
- DPA/Agreement: I'll attach our standard DPA and our procurement/legal contact info.
- Vendor form: please fill any sections you need; we will also complete the Redwood_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf with billing/legal details.
- Insurance: we'll include our current GL and cyber insurance declarations.

Can you confirm whether Kiln requires notarized originals or certified copies for any of these? Also — what's the email for your purchase order operations (so we can route billing set-up forms correctly)?

We're aiming to share a Drive folder by EOD tomorrow (Mon) and can set a 30-min synchronous call on Tuesday AM if that helps get the PO issued.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships (on behalf of Vendor Ops)
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf (fillable PDF)

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pre-procurement compliance bundle request — Kiln Health

Looping in our procurement lead (Lauren) — thanks Emily for the checklist. A couple of operational points from our side:

- We will place the compliance artifacts in a shared Drive folder and provide a single link. Expect: SOC2_redacted.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_2025.pdf, ISO27001_cert.pdf, DPA_v1.2.pdf, Insurance_Declaration.pdf.
- For PO routing: please send the PO to billing@redwood.ai and cc vendorops@redwood.ai — if Kiln uses a billing portal, let us know and we'll complete the profile.
- If legal needs a specific contract redline window, please indicate (we typically request 3 business days for review).

If helpful, I can host a 20-minute security intake on Tuesday at 10:00 AM ET to walk through any gaps (SOC scope, data residency, encryption in transit/storage). Vanessa — can you confirm that slot?

Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Thanks Vanessa and Marcus — this is perfect. Kiln confirms:

- No notarized docs needed — redacted PDFs are fine.
- PO will be issued to billing@redwood.ai once legal has the compliance bundle.
- Please include the SOC scope statement (systems in scope) where possible.
- Tuesday 10:00 AM ET works for a short intake call. My calendar is updated; I'll send a Teams invite.

I've uploaded the filled Kiln spreadsheet and added our procurement contact details to the Drive folder (link below). For our records, can you also add a one-sentence summary of the SOC scope and the date of the pen test in the Drive readme?

Link to folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cKiln-Compliance

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the call.

Emily
